description: Implementation of various iterator classes for traversing dictionary-like data structures in the base namespace, including dict_iterator, const_dict_iterator, and their proxies.

classes.name: dict_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing mutable dictionary entries.

classes.name: const_dict_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing immutable dictionary entries.

classes.name: dict_iterator_proxy
classes.description: Proxy providing iterator access to a DictStorage for mutable traversal.

classes.name: const_dict_iterator_proxy
classes.description: Proxy providing iterator access to a const DictStorage for immutable traversal.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the iterator to access the current key-value pair.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer-like access to the current element.

methods.name: operator++
methods.description: Pre-increment operator to move to the next element.

methods.name: operator++(int)
methods.description: Post-increment operator to move to the next element.

methods.name: operator--
methods.description: Pre-decrement operator to move to the previous element.

methods.name: operator--(int)
methods.description: Post-decrement operator to move to the previous element.
